# Kantipur Carpets

> Hand-knotted Nepalese carpets from Kathmandu workshops — wool, silk, hemp, nettle, bamboo, linen, pashmina and banana fibre.

Kantipur Carpet Craft Industries (K.C.C.I) weaves carpets on its own looms in Kathmandu, Nepal. The site is an editorial catalogue and enquiry channel — not an e-commerce checkout. There are no prices, no cart and no online payment; every piece is quoted against an enquiry.

## Primary pages

- Home: /en
- Collection (catalogue): /en/collection
- Bespoke (commissions, trade and hospitality): /en/bespoke
- The House (craft, heritage and the company): /en/house
- Contact & enquiries: /en/contact

Locales: English (/en), Arabic (/ar), French (/fr), German (/de). Every page exists at each prefix; Arabic renders right-to-left.

## Catalogue

- 85 photographed pieces, each at /en/collection/<slug>
- Filterable by fibre, colour and knot grade
- Each piece lists design number, material, knot grade, colour and finished size
- Knot grades in the current catalogue: 60, 80 and 100 K.N. (knots per inch)
- Fibres: wool, silk, hemp, nettle, bamboo, linen, pashmina, banana

## What we make

- Hand-knotted carpets and rugs, Tibetan rod-and-loop technique on vertical looms
- Standard collection pieces and bespoke commissions (size, colour, motif, knot grade)
- Single-loom pieces up to roughly 25 x 40 feet, so hall carpets have no seam
- Repeat and phased orders held to one dye lot across rooms or floors
- Workshop visits in Kathmandu by appointment

Not offered: machine-made, tufted or power-loomed carpets; off-the-shelf online purchase.

## Who commissions

- Private clients — a single piece for a particular room
- Architects and interior designers — work from supplied drawings, plans or fabric references
- Hospitality — suites to ballroom floors, with documentation for procurement

## How to enquire

- Contact form: /en/contact
- Commission brief form: /en/bespoke#begin
- WhatsApp (floating button on every page)

## Standards

- Hand-knotted in the company's own Kathmandu workshops, not outsourced
- Child-labour-free production by adult Nepalese weavers; GoodWeave-aligned
- Country-of-origin documentation and workshop audits on request
- Export finishing, packing and labelling by room or phase

## Company

- Name: Kantipur Carpet Craft Industries (K.C.C.I), trading as Kantipur Carpets
- Location: Kathmandu, Nepal
- Production: 200+ looms, 1,200+ adult weavers, 500+ designs (as stated on site)
- Sister house: a second design voice sharing the same workshop standard
